Work / Sessions shows NO approval card for the silent run
the silently authorized run completes on the qualified harness/model and writes at least one file (14s)
the silence is attributable: a standing_draw receipt (operation session_execute, envelope hash, admission intent) is on the run's session — the draw-down receipt exists, no dialog was suppressed
OVER THE ENVELOPE: a second run under the same 1-usage envelope fails CLOSED and typed (refused_outside_envelope / max_usages), nothing ran, no card, and the refusal receipt names the bound

the written artifacts of the silently authorized run are in the session's workspace on disk
the session record carries the execute receipt binding the consumed capability lease — the standing draw is the lease's admission

the operator rotates the approver key: a NEW key is custodied at the same path, the retired key is versioned read-only, and the chain holds an Active successor binding (version n+1) for the new authority
a run approved AFTER rotation is signed with the new key, accepted by the daemon against the rotated binding, executes and receipts
the operator revokes the principal's approval authority: the chain holds a Revoked successor that retains the exact prior authority snapshot
AFTER revocation a new run fails CLOSED with a typed authority error before any harness runs — no approval card, no execute receipt, nothing written
